upstream.fdb_cache: foreverdb-addon cache (https://foreverdb.net, GPL-3.0 + credit 'Data from ForeverDB.net', build 1.60.1.70707)

method: structured addon data only, no scraping; fill-plan computed against the live db shards: a field is emitted only when the db slot is empty; xp kept only when the capture says src=measured (curve-derived estimates and guide claims dropped); coordinates are Forever uiMap percent (quest.js contract); race masks decoded via the vanilla race-bit table; mask 255 (all races) not emitted; ids <= 0 dropped
none_marker_policy: gap-hunt-v1: a real fc-cache value supersedes the v3 known-empty marker (cmangos template zero) for the same key; merge_quest_hunt.py releases the key from the record's none list when it fills it (Forever live capture beats the classic template per prompts/gap-hunt-v1.md)

fill_plan.note: fill_plan printed by the generator at build time. The cache's exclusiveTo carries [0] (no-exclusive sentinel) on 3,232 quests and real ids on exactly the 262 quests the db already covers — the x>0 filter drops the sentinels, so chain/reward/exclusive fields add nothing new; the fills are the remaining quest POIs. none_marker_policy stays in merge_quest_hunt.py for future parts.
